label: 용령파 · 스킬
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE production 2D RPG CHARACTER ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET, not a poster. Genuine transparent RGBA background throughout, including gutters. Use the attached master as the exact identity, body proportions, costume and sword model. SAME long black-haired adult male, ivory open robe and dark embroidered hems, dark armored sword arm with gold dragon shoulder, black/gold waist, flat black/gold boots, ornate dragon hilt with long thin perfectly STRAIGHT sword. Natural adult anatomy and small head, no chibi. Preserve soft organic hair, no plate/ribbon chunks. Every frame has the SAME head size, limb proportions, costume scale, sword length and lighting.
EXACT GRID: 3 columns by 2 rows, SIX animation cells read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Landscape 1536x1024, each cell 512x512. No visible grid, labels, numbers or outlines. A complete uncropped body, sword, hair and fabric fits entirely inside EACH cell with 7% transparent margins. Consistent orthographic three-quarter view facing SCREEN RIGHT, camera never pans or zooms. Standing foot line is 90% of each cell, hip x at 48%. Fixed character world scale across cells; knees may bend but never scale the drawing. No dragon or aura or background baked into body frames, these are separate VFX.
Each of the six cells is a DISTINCT DRAWN sequential pose of the same continuous action, not a copy moved or rotated. Preserve solid physical sword rigidity, genuine hand-to-hilt contact, five correct fingers and logical joints. Long silk panels and hair follow body inertia with soft organic flow, do not cover face/hand/blade.
ANIMATION: Elegant dragon command casting: 1 ready low sword; 2 rotate torso slightly and raise open free palm near chest; 3 extend free palm toward screen right fingers naturally spread, sword firmly controlled down; 4 commanding palm thrust and slight forward lean; 5 gently lower casting arm; 6 return to exact relaxed ready. Build clear arm/hand changes across distinct frames, no effects baked in.
